mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over the past 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust aggregate demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 700000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 105.0 over the past 3 months signals robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns during late-cycle expansion regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0 and the regime is late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, increasing discount rates for equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1500 thousand units over the past 3 months signals strong housing market activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1500, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above 160,000 thousand persons over the past 3 months signals a strong labor market, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 160000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100.0 over the past 3 months signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profit growth and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
